themes.label: Public-to-private buyout offers on listed companies
themes.note: Sponsors, strategics and insiders keep taking listed businesses off public markets, and targets are increasingly pushing back on price. Wendy's independent committee rejected Trian's $7.35-a-share bid and adopted a poison pill (wen-trian-take-private), and Helen of Troy's board rejected Empower Brands' $37-a-share cash proposal (hele-empower-takeover-proposal). LCI rejected Monomoy's $101-a-share approach in favour of its Patrick merger (lcii-monomoy-takeover-proposal), and Challenger rejected a A$11.80 bid from TAL Daiichi Life (cgf-tal-daiichi-takeover-proposal). In Australia, AVID matched Warburg Pincus at A$5.45 a security for Ingenia (ina-avid-takeover-proposal). Signed deals keep moving: Tata settled its Iveco offer with ~89% (ivg-tata-motors-takeover-offer), Thrive Holdings is buying ADT with a go-shop to 28 November (adt-thrive-take-private), Bon Secours is taking Surgery Partners private (sgry-bon-secours-take-private), EQT has recommended offers for Qiagen (qgen-eqt-take-private) and Cleanaway (cwy-eqt-infrastructure-take-private), Affle is delisting Perion (peri-affle-acquisition), and EP Group's Fnac Darty tender closes on 9 November (fnac-ep-group-takeover-bid).

themes.label: Signed M&A deals hitting regulatory or legal roadblocks
themes.note: Regulators and supervisors, not the parties, keep setting deal timelines. The ECB has authorised Intesa to control Monte dei Paschi, leaving Consob, which is expected to rule on the offer document around 9-10 November, and Italy's antitrust authority as the remaining gatekeepers (isp-bmps-takeover-offer). DoorDash's $17bn Instacart deal is expected to draw an in-depth US antitrust probe, with closing not before late 2027 (cart-doordash-uber-acquisition), and Marvell's $115bn Lumentum deal is not expected to close until 2028 (mrvl-lumentum-acquisition). EP Group's Fnac Darty bid needed EU merger clearance before its tender could close (fnac-ep-group-takeover-bid).

themes.label: Large-caps scaling up buybacks on surplus cash
themes.note: Companies with surplus capital keep expanding buybacks. Lam Research authorized a new open-ended $25bn programme, far above the ~$3.9bn it repurchased in fiscal 2026 (lrcx-buyback-2026); GM authorized a new $20bn buyback with its Q3 results (gm-buyback-2026); and Simpson Manufacturing replaced a $200m authorization with $1.0bn (ssd-buyback-2026).

themes.label: European incumbents consolidating domestic rivals for scale
themes.note: Europe's large chemicals groups, banks and grocers are buying rivals to reach the scale of US and Chinese peers, while controlling shareholders, governments and supervisors decide the outcomes. Evonik's board has refused to negotiate over BASF's €24-a-share approach, so RAG-Stiftung's ~43% stake is the decisive lever (evk-basf-acquisition). Intesa Sanpaolo has ECB authorisation for its Delfin-backed offer for Monte dei Paschi (isp-bmps-takeover-offer). Ahold Delhaize is buying Tesco's Czech and Slovak arm to make its Albert chain Czechia's market leader (ad-tesco-cz-sk-acquisition).

themes.label: North American energy companies buying scale in core assets
themes.note: Oil, gas, refining and fuels companies are paying up to deepen positions in assets they already know. EQT agreed an all-stock deal for Range Resources to consolidate Appalachian gas (eqt-range-resources-acquisition), Ovintiv is buying Logan Energy to add Montney acreage (ovv-logan-energy-acquisition), CVR Energy is buying Marathon Petroleum's two Upper Midwest refineries for ~$4.2bn (cvi-mpc-refineries-acquisition), and The Andersons is paying $915m for Harvestone's three ethanol plants (ande-harvestone-acquisition).
